milestones.label: Loop becomes the igr plugin skill
milestones.why: Baseline: /igr:ticket start|finish with the progress band, moved out of ~/.claude/skills.

milestones.label: Trivial changes skip codex
milestones.why: A change that needs no design and nothing for codex to check is edited, pushed and reviewed in-session, with no codex round trips.

milestones.label: Loop runs on tk
milestones.why: SKILL.md and loop.md now call the tk plumbing CLI (added in 141bb05) for the ticket lifecycle instead of the session doing each step by hand.

milestones.label: Overengineering pass over every plan row
milestones.why: Extra design-phase check on each plan row (after efd9e52). Meant to shrink the plan: costs in design, should save in develop and review.

milestones.label: Rejected simpler options need measured reasons
milestones.why: Each plan row names the simplest alternative with a measured-or-guessed reason; a guessed reason means measure or take the simpler option. More measuring in design.

milestones.label: Two independent passes for judgment findings
milestones.why: Review, bot and CI findings on the judgment track get two independent codex passes before a fix. Mechanical findings go in one brief.

milestones.label: Behaviour change mid-PR reruns all reviews
milestones.why: Any behaviour change inside a PR reruns the reviews on the full PR diff.

milestones.label: Clear codex between plan steps, short tool output
milestones.why: Codex is cleared between plan steps, effort is set per step, tests get timeouts, tool output is kept short.

milestones.label: DB and integration tests run in hosted CI
milestones.why: Database and integration tests run in hosted CI, locally only to diagnose. Less local test running and output.

milestones.label: KISS pass over the whole design
milestones.why: One more pass over the full design before the approval report. Adds a pass, aims to cut the design.

milestones.label: Read related tickets before the plan
milestones.why: The plan starts by reading related tickets, and a drift check runs at every checkpoint.

milestones.label: Resume mode and /clear handoffs
milestones.why: The session is cleared and resumed from a checkpoint at approval, at PR-ready and between PRs, so later phases stop carrying the design conversation.

milestones.label: Independent briefs carry the measuring commands
milestones.why: Codex re-measured from scratch because the brief named what to measure but not how; with the commands it stops rebuilding the method.

milestones.label: tk go starts or resumes a ticket
milestones.why: One shell command launches the ticket worktree at start or resume.
